sloka: स्नुषा दशरथस्य त्वं रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।जनकस्य सुता राज्ञः स्वागतं ते पतिव्रते ।। ७.४९.११ ॥
transliteration: snuṣā daśarathasya tvaṁ rāmasya mahiṣī priyā ।janakasya sutā rājñaḥ svāgataṁ te pativrate ।। 7.49.11 ॥

translations.english: Valmiki addressed Sita, saying, "You are the daughter-in-law of Dasharatha, the beloved queen of Rama, and the daughter of King Janaka; welcome to you, O chaste wife."
